hits.about: XL Tower is a modern 25-storey office building designed by developer Damac Properties in the heart of Dubai's Business Bay district. The large windows allow a large amount of natural light into the premises, which provides a calm environment conducive to work. The views of the Dubai Canal are incredible.  XL Tower has a unique oval shape, which makes it stand out from the surrounding landscape. The 19 floors of the complex house spacious offices, while visitors can find retail space on the podium floors.  The uniqueness of XL Tower lies in the fact that professionals can combine business and leisure on its territory. There is a fully equipped gym and a dedicated aerobics room, and there are indoor jogging and walking paths around the building. On the roof of the tower is an oval-shaped swimming pool surrounded by sun loungers. From here you can enjoy breathtaking 360-degree views of the Business Bay skyline.Another feature of the complex is its location close to the main highways of the city. From XL Tower it takes approximately 9 minutes to Dubai Mall, 20 minutes to Palm Jumeirah, 19 minutes to Burj Al Arab and 24 minutes to The Walk JBR. Dubai International Airport is approximately 20 minutes away and Al Maktoum International Airport is approximately 41 minutes away. Xl Tower is a unique location where professionals can enjoy a comfortable working environment and enjoy their free time.
hits.title: XL Tower
